It freezes the implementation detail that is easiest to lose in code: all 15 item paths, all 8 story-choice paths, exact story event/state identifiers, late-acquisition behaviour, and Primeval Reach completion access.

blocks.text: Items are consumed on evolution; there are no trade evolutions.
The minimum level is a floor. The item may be used at any later eligible level.

Guaranteed authored sources and renewable/replacement sourcing are governed by Checklist 06. Fourteen ordinary evolution items are renewable at Ramelle; Sun Relic uses its special late source plus postgame replacement service.
3. Story event transaction ledger — four one-time decisions
4. Story evolution path ledger — 8 paths
Legacy STORY_* identifiers are compatibility/path checks only. Code must derive them from the authoritative enum or matching historical EVO trigger rather than persisting a second independent truth.
5. Universal eligibility algorithm
Read the source species’ canonical evolution row(s).

For LEVEL method: eligibility begins when current level reaches the authored level. Resolve the triggering level-up growth rolls first, then evolve if the normal evolution opportunity is accepted/automatic under the game’s standard presentation.
For ITEM method: require current level ≥ minimum and possession/use of the exact evolution item. Passing the minimum does not close the opportunity.
For STORY CHOICE method: require current level ≥ minimum and the matching authoritative family enum value / EVO trigger. The opposite branch must evaluate false throughout the main game.

If a story decision is committed while an eligible source is already above the minimum, queue the chosen evolution for the next safe evolution opportunity after the WLD event. Never interrupt the decision scene.
If the source is obtained after the WLD event, read the save’s existing family choice; do not recreate or replay the choice.
On evolution, apply the signed six-stat target-minus-source base-stat deltas once; preserve the instance and growth history. All later level-ups use the target form’s growth weights.

7. Promotion transaction invariant

rows: For each of HP / Attack / Defense / Sp. Atk / Sp. Def / Speed: target base stat − source base stat.
Legal. Do not clamp to zero or preserve the higher source stat.
None at evolution. Do not reroll growth history or Growth Seed.
If new max HP is lower, cap current HP to the new max. Evolution grants no separate full heal.
Target-form growth percentages apply to every level-up after the evolution transaction.
The same individual instance persists through evolution.
